h1: Circle cutting machines and flanging machines
intro: Circle cutting machines (circle shears, circle cutters) cut round blanks and rings from sheet for tank heads, fan housings, flanges, lids and gaskets; a flanging machine then turns the edge of the disc up for a dished or flat tank head. ISITAN's IDK series runs from the motorized IDK-1.8 to the hydraulic IDK-5 cutting 78.7″ discs in 3/16″ steel. The SDK 6 and SDK 8 cut and flange dished heads up to Ø15 ft in 5/16″ plate on the same head, and the EFM 6 does the same for elliptical heads. Sold with CSA-approved panels and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

faq.q: How does a circle cutting machine work?
faq.a: The sheet is clamped at its centre on a spindle and turned by hand or motor while two rotary blades shear a circle at the radius set on the arm. On the IDK-5, 3.5 and 2 a second pass at a smaller radius cuts the inside diameter, leaving a ring; the blank can then be flanged on the IDK-5's optional attachment.

faq.q: What size and thickness can be cut?
faq.a: From Ø4.3″ up to Ø78.7″ (2 m) depending on the model, in mild steel from 14 ga on the IDK-1.8 and IDK-2 to 3/16″ on the hydraulic IDK-5. Stainless steel reduces the capacity by roughly one gauge; ask us for the model that suits your material.

The centre clamp holds the sheet on the spindle while it rotates. The IDK-5 clamps hydraulically and the IDK-3.5 pneumatically (116 psi shop air) — fast and consistent for production; the IDK-2 and IDK-1.8 clamp by hand screw, which is fine for a few parts at a time.

faq.q: How does a tank-head flanging machine work?
faq.a: The plate disc is clamped on the part carrier and rotated while a top and bottom flanging roll, driven through planetary gearboxes, turn its edge up to the radius of the roll set — R1″ as supplied, other radii optional. On the SDK 6 and SDK 8 the same head first cuts the disc from the square plate with rotary blades, so a dished or flat head is cut and flanged without moving it; hydraulic lateral supports hold large heads and the LCD touchscreen runs the cycle.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
